sentences.en: I have two brothers and a sister.
sentences.es: Tengo dos hermanos y una hermana.
sentences.pt: Tenho dois irmãos e uma irmã.

sentences.es: A mi padre le encanta cocinar.

A minha filha faz seis anos.

sentences.es: Te presento a mi amigo Tom.

sentences.en: We've been together for ten years.

sentences.pt: O meu melhor amigo vive no estrangeiro.

passages.text: En mi familia somos cinco: mis padres, mis dos hermanos y yo. Yo soy la mayor. Mis abuelos viven en un pueblo y vamos a verlos todos los veranos.
passages.en: There are five of us in my family: my parents, my two brothers and me. I'm the eldest. My grandparents live in a village and we visit them every summer.
passages.question: How many children are in the family?

passages.text: Na minha família somos cinco: os meus pais, os meus dois irmãos e eu. Eu sou a mais velha. Os meus avós vivem numa aldeia e vamos visitá-los todos os verões.
passages.en: There are five of us in my family: my parents, my two brothers and me. I'm the eldest. My grandparents live in a village and we visit them every summer.
passages.question: How many children are in the family?

passages.text: El sábado es el cumpleaños de mi hija, cumple seis. Hacemos una fiesta en el parque a las cinco con sus amigos del colegio. Si vienes con los niños, mejor.
passages.en: Saturday is my daughter's birthday; she's turning six. We're having a party in the park at five with her school friends. If you come with the kids, even better.
passages.question: Where and when is the party?
passages.answer: In the park on Saturday at five.
wrong: At home on Sunday at five.
At school on Saturday at six.
In the park on Friday at six.

passages.text: No sábado é o aniversário da minha filha, faz seis anos. Vamos fazer uma festa no parque às cinco com os amigos da escola. Se vieres com os miúdos, melhor.
passages.en: Saturday is my daughter's birthday; she's turning six. We're having a party in the park at five with her school friends. If you come with the kids, even better.

passages.text: Mi hermano es fácil de reconocer: es altísimo, lleva gafas redondas y siempre va con una chaqueta amarilla. Es un poco tímido al principio, pero luego no para de hablar.
passages.en: My brother is easy to recognise: he's very tall, wears round glasses and always has a yellow jacket. He's a bit shy at first, but then he never stops talking.
passages.question: How do you recognise the brother?
passages.answer: Very tall, round glasses, yellow jacket.

passages.text: O meu irmão é fácil de reconhecer: é altíssimo, usa óculos redondos e anda sempre com um casaco amarelo. É um bocado tímido ao princípio, mas depois não se cala.
passages.en: My brother is easy to recognise: he's very tall, wears round glasses and always has a yellow jacket. He's a bit shy at first, but then he never stops talking.
passages.question: How do you recognise the brother?
passages.answer: Very tall, round glasses, yellow jacket.

passages.text: Nos conocimos en la universidad, en Salamanca, hace ya quince años. Primero fuimos amigos, después pareja, y nos casamos hace cinco. Ahora vivimos en Madrid con dos gatos.
passages.en: We met at university fifteen years ago. First we were friends, then a couple, and we got married five years ago. Now we live in the capital with two cats.
passages.question: When did they get married?

passages.text: Conhecemo-nos na universidade, em Coimbra, há já quinze anos. Primeiro fomos amigos, depois namorados, e casámo-nos há cinco. Agora vivemos em Lisboa com dois gatos.
passages.en: We met at university fifteen years ago. First we were friends, then a couple, and we got married five years ago. Now we live in the capital with two cats.
passages.question: When did they get married?
